_comment: Alaska Air Group FY2025 (data/edgar/ALK.json) plus illustrative market inputs (risk-free = 10yr UST, ERP = Damodaran implied ERP, beta = illustrative for a network airline -- high operating leverage and demand cyclicality). Coverage-based synthetic rating (ebit/interest_expense) replaces a real credit rating, same convention as examples/wacc_stld.json -- unlike the bank and REIT checks, an airline's debt is ordinary financing debt (aircraft debt, EETCs, revolvers), so a real debt-weighted WACC applies without the caveats those two checks needed.
